recommendation: Keep the empty external-repo audit commit for core reconciliation. If future maintenance is needed, make it in HL7/fhir-extensions or the v2-to-FHIR mapping IG rather than adding a duplicate extension definition to core.
issue_request: FHIR-33038 is an Applied, Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Observation change request from the v2-to-FHIR project. It asked for a standard Observation extension for OBX-4/SubID, ultimately described as an extension representing the v2 OG data type and later renamed from observation-grouper to observation-v2-subid.
initial_application: The Jira application commits 68068e8 and ea14136 are present in HL7/fhir-extensions. They added the observation-grouper StructureDefinition and then renamed the canonical to http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/observation-v2-subid. Core history only showed the canonical in source/oids.ini via a later OID refresh.
additional_context: Current core source/fhir.ini keeps Observation active but has no active [profiles] entry for observation-v2-subid. The Extension Pack IG builds input/definitions/* resources, and the current Extension Pack source has an active Observation V2 Sub-Id StructureDefinition with Observation context and OG.1 through OG.4 component slices. Confluence OO minutes around December 2023 track FHIR-33038 as a v2-to-FHIR extension application item; the quoted Zulip search found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The requested artifact is already implemented in the Extension Pack, which is outside this FHIR core checkout, and adding a duplicate core profile entry would be the wrong build-scope fix. The existing core OID assignment for the canonical URL remains consistent with the external definition.
